description: Schokland rises only slightly out of the Noordoostpolder. The dark wooden Enserkerk and the low museum houses sit on that former island, with a small light structure nearby and flat fields running to the horizon. The sky is mainly clear, about 12.4°C, with wind near 8.3 km/h. Sunset was 19:26. No crowd is on the terp.
